## Description

A pear-shaped suctorian (17–50 µm) on a short stalk, with two bundles of capitate tentacles that catch
ciliates and suck out their cytoplasm. In the laboratory it is reared on *Tetrahymena*. It reproduces
by internal budding: a ciliated swarmer leaves swimming and the mother stays attached.
